# Schedule 2 — Service Level Terms

> **DRAFT FOR LEGAL/OPS REVIEW.** Taken from Exhibit C of the old Service Agreement (OC202610009). Contacts are filled from the Master Sheet (CommercialTerms tab), so they can change without editing the template.

## 1. Availability
The Services shall be available **{{UptimePct}}**, measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance and emergency maintenance notified in advance where practicable. Downtime caused by the Customer, by Customer-requested maintenance, or by third-party networks (SMS, WhatsApp, email providers) is excluded.

## 2. How to reach us
1. **Email:** for every incident, first send an email to **{{SupportEmail}}**.
2. **Chat (WhatsApp):** if no response is received within the first-response time below.
3. **Call:** only for showstopper issues (major services not working), after an email has been sent: **{{SupportPhone}}** (may change from time to time).

## 3. Escalation matrix
| Level | Contact |
|---|---|
| Support team | {{SupportEmail}} |
| Customer Success Manager | As will be indicated |
| Sales | {{RepName}} · {{RepEmail}} |
| Executive Director, OptCulture | {{ExecutiveName}} · {{ExecutiveEmail}} |

## 4. Working hours
Regular working and support hours are **{{SupportHours}}**. Emergency contact can be made any time, any day.

## 5. Support terms
- OptCulture will use reasonable efforts to respond to all helpdesk tickets within one (1) business day, subject to the severity levels below.
- Training is provided once during initial implementation. Further training requests are chargeable.

## 6. Severity levels
| Severity | Examples | First response | Resolution target |
|---|---|---|---|
| Critical | App down; FTP files or loyalty transactions not processing | 30 minutes | 4 hours |
| High | Point adjustments, promo codes failing, campaigns not sending | 60 minutes | 24 hours |
| Medium | Segment export issues, plugin error messages, sales data not received | 60 minutes | 48 hours |
| Low | Bulk promo creation, new or existing store installation | 120 minutes | 72 hours |

## 7. Service requests (non-standard requests may be chargeable)
| Request | Target |
|---|---|
| General queries about the app | 1 day |
| Email template | 2 days |
| Web form / loyalty web portal | 2 weeks |
| Ad hoc report | On estimate |
| Data pull | 2 days |
| Reported plugin issue | 3 weeks |
| Application support (if included in the agreement) | 2 days |

> Reviewer note: "Resolution" times are targets, not guarantees, unless service credits are agreed. Decide whether to offer service credits for missing 99.9%.
